title: Machado is back in Venezuela. Why it matters

scenes.title: Machado is back in Venezuela. Why it matters
scenes.say: After 10 months in exile, Venezuela's opposition leader is back. Here's why it matters.
scenes.speak: After ten months in exile, Venezuela's opposition leader is back. Here's why it matters.

scenes.title: "I am here. With you"
scenes.say: On 25 October, Nobel laureate María Corina Machado posted on X: I am here. With you. She didn't say how she got in.
scenes.speak: On the twenty-fifth of October, Nobel laureate María Corina Machado posted on X: I am here. With you. She didn't say how she got in.

scenes.title: Ten months that changed Venezuela
scenes.say: She was last seen at home in December. In January, the US military deposed Nicolás Maduro. Three days before her return, supporters rallied for an election date.

scenes.title: Greeting supporters in Barquisimeto
scenes.say: Photos from her party showed her greeting supporters at a church in Barquisimeto.

scenes.title: On trial in the United States
scenes.say: Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, face US federal charges, including narco-terrorism and cocaine conspiracy. Both have pleaded not guilty.

scenes.title: An interim order, backed by Washington
scenes.say: Power passed to his vice-president, Delcy Rodríguez. Donald Trump has backed her and welcomed US oil deals.

scenes.label: Election dates set. Rodríguez has stayed past her authorised term
scenes.say: But Rodríguez has stayed past her authorised term, and no election has been scheduled. Machado's return makes that hard to ignore.

scenes.title: Venezuelan crude, Indian refiners
items: Washington wants India to refine Venezuelan oil
Jamnagar can handle its heavy grades
Deals depend on who rules Caracas
scenes.say: For India, it's about oil. Washington wants Indian refiners to process Venezuelan crude. But those deals depend on who rules in Caracas.
